description: Answer key: tests that are broken ON PURPOSE (the test is wrong, not the app). The AI must NEVER read this file. It is only used afterwards to score the AI.

brokenTests.test: shows product names in the list
brokenTests.explanation: Uses data-testid 'product-title', but the page uses 'product-name'.

brokenTests.test: shows the correct price for Notebook
brokenTests.explanation: Typo in the expected value: $4.57 instead of $4.75 (the real price in the product data).

brokenTests.test: checkout succeeds for a customer email
brokenTests.explanation: 'customer@example' is not a valid email (no domain ending), so the app correctly rejects it.

brokenTests.test: order confirmation shows the customer's email
brokenTests.explanation: Clicks 'Place order' BEFORE adding a product, so the app correctly says the cart is empty.
brokenTests.fix: Call addToCart(...) before filling the email and clicking checkout

brokenTests.explanation: Reads textContent() immediately after clicking, before the server answers. textContent() does not wait or retry.

brokenTests.test: GET product by id returns that product
account page shows the signed-in user after 2FA
brokenTests.explanation: Types a fixed 2FA code (492039) copied from the authenticator app when the test was written. The code changes every 30 seconds, so the test can never pass again.
Reads res.headers()["X-Content-Type-Options"], but Playwright returns header names in lowercase, so the value is always undefined even though the header is sent.
